decisions.summary: Approved option A: Approve the exact fixed-path authority contract, custody assumptions, and separated Owner approval client bound by work-packages/DEC-RC1-APPROVER-AUTHORITY-R22.md.
decisions.scope: For repository github.com/zycaskevin/agentic-sdd-governance and trust domain agentic-sdd-governance-owner-2026q3, retire and reject SDDGOV_TRUSTED_APPROVERS_FILE; make logical /etc/sddgov/trusted-approvers.json the sole Linux/macOS runtime approver key store; require the Base-compatible signed receipt plus the fixed root-controlled /etc/sddgov/trusted-approver-domains.json sidecar binding the Owner key to that repository, one exact separately provisioned host-local repository root, and that trust domain; and add the separated non-signing Agent card plus Owner-terminal Agent-inaccessible-signer flow, under the exact ownership, path-chain, migration, custody, fail-closed, and non-provisioning boundaries in work-packages/DEC-RC1-APPROVER-AUTHORITY-R22.md.
